function renderMermaidBlocks(container): Promise<void>;

Defined in: experiments/docs/mermaid.ts:58

Renders every unprocessed .docs-mermaid block inside container into an inline SVG diagram. Safe to call repeatedly — mermaid marks processed nodes (data-processed), so later payloads don't re-render earlier diagrams.

Parameters

container

HTMLElement

The docs-content box holding rendered payload HTML.
